# Data
MiniDot data are stored as daily .txt files, we will need to get all of these into one nice csv per logger
```{r}
#this directory should be pointed to a parent folder that includes all sensors from a lake 
do.directory <- file.path(
  "D:",
  "Shared drives",
  "Hansen Lab",
  "RESEARCH PROJECTS",
  "LCCMR Coldwater Habitat Watersheds - MM",
  "Data",
  "TDO sensors",
  "Hansen",
  "Raw Data",
  "Sensor Data Fall 2026",
  "Black Bear",
  "20260903"
)
#let's see what files are in here
list.files(do.directory, recursive = F)
#recursive makes sure that we don't include the parent file name

#now lets make paths to each of the sensor folders
do.folders <- list.dirs(do.directory,
                        recursive = F,
                        full.names = T)
#don't include the file where we will store compiled data
do.folders <- do.folders[
  basename(do.folders) != "compile"
]
do.folders <- do.folders[basename(do.folders) != "cat_files"]
#check to see if we have the folders we want to compile
do.folders

# run the function for compiling for all folder and save into the compile folder
for (i in do.folders) {

  compile_do_folder(
    folderpath = i,
    savetofolder = file.path(do.directory, "compile")
  )

}
```
